histories.history: Renumbered and Amended by Chapter 172, 2025 General Session

section.catchline: Claim applied against tax liability -- One claimant per household per year.
section.subsection: A county shall apply as provided in Subsection 59-2a-303 the amount of a credit under this part against:a claimant's property tax liability; orthe property tax liability of a spouse who was a member of the claimant's household in the year in which the claimant applies for a homeowner's credit under this part.
Only one claimant per household per year is entitled to payment under this part.
